parrafo.es: Chef Cuinn es un chef privado y servicio de catering en West Palm Beach. Cuinn Sealy cocina cenas íntimas, brunch y eventos completos, armando el menú junto a cada cliente antes de ponerse el delantal. Cocina de mariscos, americana, italiana y fusión caribeña, servida con una presentación cuidada.
parrafo.en: Chef Cuinn is a private chef and catering service based in West Palm Beach. Cuinn Sealy cooks intimate dinners, brunches and full events, building the menu together with each client before he ever picks up a pan. Seafood, American, Italian and Caribbean fusion, all served with careful plating.

hero.imagen_alt: Surf and turf dinner plated by Chef Cuinn, with lobster tail, filet and green beans

parrafo_1.es: Chef Cuinn es el servicio de catering y chef privado de Cuinn Sealy, chef de cocina con base en West Palm Beach. Cocina de todo: cenas íntimas en casa, brunch de celebración y catering para eventos grandes, siempre con mariscos, cocina americana, italiana y fusión caribeña en el menú.
parrafo_1.en: Chef Cuinn is the catering and private chef service run by Cuinn Sealy, chef de cuisine based in West Palm Beach. He covers it all: intimate dinners at home, celebration brunches and catering for larger events, always working seafood, American, Italian and Caribbean fusion into the menu.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes repiten lo mismo en las reseñas de Google: profesional, creativo y con una presentación de platos que da de qué hablar. Varios lo describen trabajando sus propios eventos de catering, manejando el presupuesto y cualquier imprevisto sin perder la calma.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing in their Google reviews: professional, creative, and the kind of plating that gets people talking. Several describe working with him on their own catering projects, handling the budget and anything that comes up along the way.

titulo.en: You call and tell him about it

texto.es: Una cena en casa, un brunch o un evento grande: cuéntale la ocasión y cuántos invitados son.
texto.en: A dinner at home, a brunch or a bigger event: tell him the occasion and how many guests you are expecting.

texto.es: Cuinn envía ideas de menú y entre los dos eligen los platos, tal como cuentan sus clientes.
texto.en: Cuinn sends over menu ideas and together you settle on the dishes, just like his clients describe.

texto.es: Mariscos, cortes a la parrilla, brunch o lo que hayan elegido, con una presentación cuidada.
texto.en: Seafood, grilled cuts, brunch or whatever you picked, plated with care.

texto.es: El plato llega listo y los invitados terminan hablando de la comida, tal como describen las reseñas.
texto.en: The plate arrives ready and guests end up talking about the food, exactly as the reviews describe.

nota.es: Cada menú se cotiza según el evento, el número de invitados y los platos elegidos. Llama y lo armamos juntos.
nota.en: Every menu is quoted based on the event, the guest count and the dishes chosen. Call and we will build it together.

texto.es: Cenas íntimas en tu propia casa, con un menú armado contigo: mariscos, cortes a la parrilla, italiana o fusión caribeña.
texto.en: Intimate dinners cooked right in your own home, with a menu built together: seafood, grilled cuts, Italian or Caribbean fusion.

texto.es: Bodas, cumpleaños y celebraciones grandes. Sus clientes lo describen manejando el presupuesto y cualquier imprevisto sin perder la calma.
texto.en: Weddings, birthdays and larger celebrations. Clients describe him handling the budget and anything that comes up without missing a beat.

texto.es: Mesas de brunch completas: charcutería, salmón ahumado, tostadas francesas y huevos benedictinos, pensadas para celebraciones.
texto.en: Full brunch spreads: charcuterie, smoked salmon, French toast and eggs benedict, built for a celebration.

texto.es: Porciones listas para la semana: proteína, vegetales y guarniciones, preparadas y empacadas para llevar.
texto.en: Ready-to-go portions for the week: protein, vegetables and sides, prepped and packed to take home.

pie.es: ¿Tienes algo distinto en mente? Llama igual, seguro lo armamos.
pie.en: Have something different in mind? Call anyway, we will figure it out.

Delicious and affordable he creates beautifully displayed foods everyone enjoys! There's always talk about how good the food tastes and looks! Highly recommended!

Chef Cuinn is the best! He cooks flavorful and delicious dishes. The menu is customizable and very affordable for the experience you receive. His fun personality contributes to the great experience and everyone in the group enjoyed it.

Chef Cuinn is a consummate professional. Passionate and artistic, whatever culinary treat he creates will be well enjoyed. I have worked with Chef Cuinn on several catering projects and am so pleased on how he handles budget, issues arising …
